Hello, I'm Deepak! I am a passionate software engineer with a strong interest in data engineering and analysis. I thrive on tackling complex problems and finding innovative solutions through collaborative teamwork. I relish challenges that enable incremental daily progress. I have a tendency to think about the big picture and target audience before dwelling into problem solving. I enjoy hobbies like learning to play guitar, reading my favourite novels and web series, and gardening. 

Currently tackling these,

- [Designing Data-Intensive Applications](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/designing-data-intensive-applications/9781098119058/), Martin Kleppmann and Chris Riccomini

- [Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)](https://sebastianraschka.com/llms-from-scratch/), Sebastian Raschka

- [AI Evals For Engineers & PMs](https://hamel.dev/blog/posts/evals-faq/), Hamel Husain and Shreya Shankar

- [Absolutely Understand Guitar](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJwa8GA7pXCWAnIeTQyw_mvy1L7ryxxPH), Scotty West


I spent my mid 20s to early 30s in Germany adapting to new culture, people etc. These formative years changed how I view professional and personal life.

I am looking for job opportunities in the field of data/software engineering.

Hope to connect with you on shared interests.
